notes.title: Right-Fire Unlock Version 2
notes.notes:
Right-Fire Unlock Version 2:
1. right-fire unlock is now needed to right-firing machine and railgun unlocks.
2. Small UI bug fixed where it would show the single pistol instead of dual pistol after unlocking machine gun or railgun before right-fire unlock.
3. More minor bugs fixed.

notes.title: Right-Click Shooting Not Working Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Right-Click Shooting Not Working Bug Fix:
1. Right click shooting was working in unity but not in build (I don't know how I missed that in testing sorry) it is now fixed.
2. Red Eye "Glow" now fixed on easy mode

notes.title: Red Eye Version 2
notes.notes:
Red Eye Version 2:
1. Bug fixed where you can attack enemies from any direction due to bad red-eye code
2. Improved red eyes: enemies eyes turn red when attacked and glow red too
3. Spawn rate clamped to a slower rate to reduce crashing

notes.title: Spawn Rate Update. Version 1.3 Is Out!
notes.notes:
So to keep this short. I increased the spawn rate by double, but I also increased the spawn max on easy, medium, and hard. I excluded very hard as it seems better with double rate. 
This being said, it SHOULD make the game more exciting without having to wait 20-30mins for more furries.
However it may impact achievement progress. Hitting wave 50 should be possible on easy mode. Hitting 1 million will still be a trick. I think I may increase the score amount globally to try to help with that issue next update.

Also Endless Furry Killer 3D launches Monday!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1519470/Endless_Furry_Killer_3D/

notes.title: Performance Improvement Update!
notes.notes:
So first off, I reduced the spawn rate per wave by 66.6666 (Repeating of course) percent!
Second off, furries will de-spawn after 50 seconds. This seems shot but its actually not that short, as each wave is 40 seconds. Leaving 10 seconds to kill the remaining furries before you will have to click the "next wave" button.

With that being said there's really not much more to it. You should be able to hit higher waves now. Unfortunately I lost my game tester. I'm hiring a personal friend in 2020 to help with game ideas, testing, and level design. He actually thought of the idea for Endless Furry Killer 2020. We already have our next game planned. However, I need to finish "Don't Crash - The Zombie Game" first. Hopefully it will launch in February 2020.

Also I wiped my entire desktop and forgot to backup my game art files. So sorry if the fonts don't match well as I lost those too.
